Annie

Support Weird but works

Stun Support Annie

How to play this build

Count your passive stacks: on the fourth spell your next damage stuns. Save that stun to drop Tibbers on the enemy ADC and finish with DFG + Ignite. Before level 6, poke with Q to save mana.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Desintegrar → W Incinerar → E Escudo Molten

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Q for single-target damage and because it refunds mana on last-hits; unlike waveclear Annie who sometimes maxes W first.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.
  3. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  4. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.
  5. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/0/9 — Offense
Why this page
21/0/9 goes full burst so the Tibbers combo one-shots.

Magic pen, armor, AP quints
